physicalNotes: Radius 0.771 +/- 0.039 solar radii from Heidari et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2537 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A..36H/abstract): 536,385 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.771 +/- 0.049 solar masses from Heidari et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2537 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A..36H/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4870 +/- 150 K from Heidari et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2537 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A..36H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
